answer: The spouse of the most recent British queen—Queen Elizabeth II—was **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh**.  He married her on 20 November 1947 and served as queen consort until his death in 2021.  (Following the accession of King Charles III, the current queen consort is Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall.)
